name: Flashcards from Text
description:
Highlight any text on a page, right-click, and turn it into ready-to-study flashcards as question-and-answer pairs — created privately on your device.

**How it works:** You select text and choose the right-click action, then a local AI model writes question/answer cards and shows them to you.

**Setup:**
- Install and enable the awflow browser extension.
- Pick an on-device AI model the first time you run it.

**Good for:** students and lifelong learners turning articles or notes into revision cards in seconds.
setup: Install / enable the awflow browser extension.
